promoted_claims.statement: The Bach-flat locus is complete within the declared six-term Laurent ansatz.
On each declared regular local quotient chart, residual basicness fixes N=u*f(J), and u*F=dH.
The residual-basic Hamiltonian obeys dH=T_h*dS_h at every locally labelled simple horizon.
The complete linear spherical conformal/diffeomorphism gauge sector does not change the charge theorem.
